text: {"lessons":["Selling winners simply because they are profitable can cut short their potential; I should base trades on my plan, not on wanting to lock in gains.","I should judge each holding by its future prospects and my overall portfolio, not treat it as a separate account anchored to its purchase price.","With prices moving randomly, recent gains and losses do not predict what comes next; I should avoid overtrading and make deliberate decisions that fit my risk tolerance."]}
